comparison.objective: Drive a nail while sharing one hammer with another robot arm.
comparison.physical_skill: Hammer grasping, striking, and inter-arm tool sharing.
comparison.success_condition: Own nail driven using the shared hammer; depth, damage, and handover criteria are absent.
comparison.reason: Percussive fastening and shared-tool coordination do not test adjustable damping, setting retention, or non-bottoming stop response. No spec versions are available.
